items.prompt: יהוה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר
items.answer: Yahweh is my shepherd, I shall not want.

items.prompt: יֶלֶד יֻלַּד־לָנוּ בֵּן נִתַּן־לָנוּ
items.answer: A child has been born to us, a son has been given to us.

items.prompt: נָבִיא אָקִים לָהֶם מִקֶּרֶב אֲחֵיהֶם כָּמוֹךָ
items.answer: A prophet will I raise up unto them from the midst of their brethren, like unto thee.

items.prompt: אִישׁ הַיָּשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו יַעֲשֶׂה
items.answer: Every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

items.prompt: רֹעֶה הָיָה עַבְדְּךָ לְאָבִיו בַּצֹּאן וּבָא הָאֲרִי וְנָשָׂא שֶׂה מֵהָעֵדֶר וְיָצָאתִי אַחֲרָיו וְהִכִּתִיו וְהִצַּלְתִּי מִפִּיו
items.answer: Thy servant was shepherding his father's flock; and if a lion came and took a sheep out of the flock, I would go out after him, and smite him, and rescue it from his mouth.

items.prompt: וְלָרָשׁ אֵין־כֹּל כִּי אִם־כִּבְשָׂה אַחַת קְטַנָּה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה וַיְחַיֶּהָ וַתִּגְדַּל עִמּוֹ וְעִם־בָּנָיו יַחְדָּו מִפִּתּוֹ תֹאכַל וּמִכֹּסוֹ תִשְׁתֶּה וּבְחֵיקוֹ תִשְׁכָּב וַתְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבַת
items.answer: The poor man had nothing but one little ewe-lamb, which he had bought and kept alive, and it grew up together with him and his children; it would eat of his morsel and drink of his cup and lie in his bosom, and it was like a daughter to him.

items.prompt: יוֹדֵעַ יהוה דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד
items.answer: Yahweh knoweth the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

items.prompt: וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה בְאֵר בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם עֶדְרֵי־צֹאן רֹבְצִים עָלֶיהָ כִּי מִן־הַבְּאֵר הַהִיא יַשְׁקוּ הָעֲדָרִים
items.answer: And he looked, and behold, a well in the field, and behold, there were flocks of sheep lying there by it, for out of that well they used to water the flocks.

items.prompt: זאת הברית אשר אכרת את־בית ישראל אחרי הימים ההם נאם־יהוה נתתי את־תורתי בקרבם ועל־לבם אכתבנה והייתי להם לאלהים והמה יהיו־לי לעם
items.answer: This is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days: I will put my law in their inward parts, and on their hearts will I write it, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

data.pointed: זֹאת הַבְּרִית אֲשֶׁר אֶכְרֹת אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵי הַיָּמִים הָהֵם נְאֻם־יְהוָה נָתַתִּי אֶת־תּוֹרָתִי בְּקִרְבָּם וְעַל־לִבָּם אֶכְתֲּבֶנָּה וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים וְהֵמָּה יִהְיוּ־לִי לְעָם

items.prompt: The more the enemy oppressed them, the more they increased.
items.answer: כַּאֲשֶׁר יְעַנּוּ אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֵּן יִרְבּוּ

items.prompt: He used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp.
items.answer: יִקַּח אֶת־הָאֹהֶל וְנָטָה מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה

items.prompt: It is not wont to be done so in our land.
items.answer: לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂה כֵן בְּאַרְצֵנוּ

items.prompt: Yahweh shall assuredly destroy the work of thy hands.
items.answer: אַבֵּד יְאַבֵּד יְהוָה אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ

items.prompt: If I perish, I perish.
items.answer: כַּאֲשֶׁר אָבַדְתִּי אָבָדְתִּי

items.prompt: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song unto their God.
items.answer: אָז יָשִׁיר מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לֵאלֹהֵיהֶם

items.prompt: Whosoever shall harden his heart and transgress my law shall be put to death.
items.answer: כָּל־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יְחַזֵּק אֶת־לִבּוֹ וְעָבַר אֶת־תּוֹרָתִי יוּמָת

items.prompt: The earth standeth for ever.
items.answer: הָאָרֶץ עֹמֶדֶת לְעוֹלָם

items.prompt: I counsel thee, let all thy people be gathered together.
items.answer: יָעַצְתִּי יֵאָסֵף כָּל־עַמְּךָ

items.prompt: They found maidens coming out to draw water.
items.answer: מָצְאוּ נְעָרוֹת יֹצְאוֹת לִשְׁאֹב מָיִם

items.prompt: All this I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and prostrate thyself before me.
items.answer: אֶת־כָּל־זֹאת נָתַתִּי לְךָ אִם־תִּקֹּד וְתִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לִי

items.prompt: A righteous man careth for the life of his beast.
items.answer: יוֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּוֹ

items.prompt: Evermore Yahweh supports all who fall.
items.answer: סוֹמֵךְ יְהוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִים

items.prompt: While he was yet speaking one of his servants came and said, We are undone—all of us.
items.answer: עוֹד הוּא מְדַבֵּר וְאֶחָד מֵעֲבָדָיו בָּא וַיֹּאמַר נִדְמִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ
